data.summary: On November 23, police detained Murmansk Governor Andrey Chibis as he stepped off the plane at Moscow’s Sheremetyevo Airport. He had flown to Moscow on official business. Authorities opened a criminal case against him on suspicion of fraud and embezzlement, making him the first sitting governor to face criminal proceedings since the war began. Chibis took charge of the Murmansk region in 2019 and was reelected in 2024. Over the past several months, law enforcement has repeatedly opened criminal investigations into key members of his team. Meduza tells the story of Andrey Chibis, a bureaucrat who developed a taste for publicity and came up with the slogan “Na Severe zhit!” (“Live in the North!”).
